newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed in response to budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed in response to budget.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to open mixed on Saturday in a special session following Friday's budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), dealers said.
Trading will start at 0530 GMT and end at 0830 GMT, an official at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
"There is a bit of confusion about the impact of the budget on various sectors and individual stocks," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said, adding that the index might move both ways.
On Friday, the KSE 100-share index rose 4.46 points, or 0.28 percent, to end at 1,575.88. Gainers led losers 60 to 29. Turnover rose to 72 million shares from 46 million on Thursday.
